name: Field
neighborhood: Staré Město · by St Agnes Convent, the quiet north end of the Old Town
product_tags: tasting menu · czech produce · lunch value
recognition: One MICHELIN Star, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025 (retained); Service Award to Miroslav Nosek
what_to_order: Arctic char, guanciale, chard, cucumber · Rabbit, veal head, velouté, black trumpet mushroom · Yogurt, apricot, lemon balm, olive oil · Ten-course degustation
price_range: Lunch 4 courses 1,950 CZK; 6 courses 3,200 CZK; 10 courses 4,900 CZK; pairings 800-6,400 CZK (own menu page, Sept 2026; one Czech guide lists 5,400 CZK for the long menu)
reservation: Online or by phone; book 2-4 weeks ahead for dinner, days ahead for lunch.
verdict: The safest star in Prague to book blind, and at lunch the best value of the five.
caveat: They hold a table for 15 minutes only; not for children under 6.

name: La Degustation Bohême Bourgeoise
neighborhood: Staré Město · Haštalská, the lanes behind St Agnes
product_tags: czech canon · tasting menu · local sourcing
recognition: One MICHELIN Star, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025 (retained)
what_to_order: Tomato, onion, basil · Trout, dill, cucumber · Rabbit, carrot, courgette · Venison, mushrooms, rosemary · Yoghurt, blueberry, thyme · Grape soda
price_range: Tasting menu 3,500 CZK; pairings 2,000 / 3,700 CZK, non-alcoholic 1,300 CZK (own menu page, Sept 2026)
reservation: Online via the site; 1-3 weeks ahead for dinner.
verdict: The room that taught Prague to be proud of Czech food; still the most Czech of the stars.
caveat: Tasting menu only; pairings nearly double the bill.

name: LEVITATE
neighborhood: Vinohrady · three floors underground on Vinohradská, near the National Museum
recognition: One MICHELIN Star, new, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: Mystery menu, 18 courses · Elite menu, 12 courses · Mushrooms on moss and stone · Choose-your-own plate and glass
price_range: 18 courses around 7,500 CZK per head, pairing extra, 1,500 CZK deposit (reported by guests and press, 2025; not published on own site)
reservation: Online; deposit reported at booking. 2-4 weeks ahead.
verdict: The most theatrical star in Prague; go if you want a performance, skip it if you want a quiet dinner.
caveat: Non-refundable deposit reported; a long evening that ends late.

name: Štangl
neighborhood: Karlín · first floor on Pernerova, the rebuilt post-flood district
recognition: One MICHELIN Star and MICHELIN Green Star, new, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: Alsatian char, cauliflower doughnut, hazelnuts · Grilled pigeon, root vegetable purée · Salmon trout, bell pepper sauce · Eska bread downstairs
price_range: 3 courses 2,200 CZK; 5 courses 3,100 CZK; pairings 800-3,300 CZK (own menu page, Sept 2026)
reservation: Online or phone (15:00-22:00 Tue-Sat); last booking 21:30.
verdict: The star to book if you hate four-hour dinners.
caveat: Closed Sunday and Monday, exactly when a crew is free.

name: Casa De Carli
neighborhood: Staré Město · a cobbled side street off Dlouhá
recognition: One MICHELIN Star, new, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: Turbot in puff pastry · House-made pasta · House-made bread · House-made ice cream
price_range: 5-, 6- or 7-course tasting menus and à la carte; prices not published online (Sept 2026)
reservation: Online or phone; 1-2 weeks ahead since the star.
verdict: The star you can take a guest who just wants excellent pasta.
caveat: Closed every weekend.

name: Restaurant Papilio
neighborhood: Vysoký Újezd · village near the Brdy forest, about 20 minutes' drive from Prague
product_tags: two stars · chef's counter · day trip
recognition: Two MICHELIN Stars, new, MICHELIN Guide Czechia 2025 (the only two-star in the country)
what_to_order: Ten-course menu · Eight-course menu · Tea pairing
price_range: 8 courses 5,500 CZK; 10 courses 6,500 CZK; pairings extra (own site, Sept 2026)
reservation: Online at the site or +420 724 132 013; book well ahead since the second star.
verdict: The highest-rated table in Czechia, and worth the drive for anyone who counts stars.
caveat: Outside the city: taxi or driver there and back; closed Sun-Tue.

name: TARO
neighborhood: Nové Město · Dunaj palace on Národní třída
recognition: MICHELIN Young Chef Award 2025 to Khanh Ta
what_to_order: Tasting menu · Congee breakfast at Paté next door · Banh mi at Paté
price_range: Tasting menu; price not published online (Sept 2026)
reservation: Online via Tableo; call for same-day seats.
verdict: The most likely next star in Prague.
caveat: Menu and prices not published on the site this month.

name: Marie B
neighborhood: Staré Město · through a graffiti courtyard on Dlouhá
recognition: MICHELIN Sommelier Award 2025 to Zdeněk Oudes; MICHELIN Selected
what_to_order: Carte blanche tasting · Moravian wine pairing · Vin de Marie
price_range: Tasting 2,150 CZK; pairings 1,300-3,000 CZK, non-alcoholic 900 CZK (own site, Sept 2026)
reservation: Online; counter seats go a week or two ahead.
verdict: Starred-kitchen thinking for 2,150 CZK; the best-value serious dinner in the Old Town.
caveat: No choice at all; declare allergies when booking.

name: Benjamin
neighborhood: Vršovice · Norská, a residential street off the Vinohrady edge
recognition: MICHELIN Selected, Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: Eight-course seasonal menu · Wine pairing
price_range: Top MICHELIN band (€€€€); price not confirmed this month
reservation: Direct with the restaurant; weeks ahead.
verdict: The most intimate serious dinner in the city; book it for two, not six.
caveat: Ten seats: miss the booking and there is no walk-in.

name: Parzival
neighborhood: Staré Město · Bookquet Hotel on Karoliny Světlé, a block from the river
product_tags: middle eastern · wine by glass · brunch
recognition: MICHELIN Selected, Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: Stone bass, verjus, XO sauce · Six-course set menu · Weekend brunch
price_range: Top MICHELIN band (€€€€); set menu price not published online (Sept 2026)
verdict: The most interesting wine list in the new wave: drink by the glass, drink east.
caveat: Four dinner nights only.

name: Terasa U Zlaté studně
neighborhood: Malá Strana · rooftop of the Golden Well hotel under the castle
recognition: Maurerův výběr Grand Restaurant, first place three times (last 2019); Gault&Millau three toques
what_to_order: Seasonal tasting menu · Steak
price_range: Seasonal tasting menu; prices not published online (Sept 2026)
reservation: Phone or restaurant@goldenwell.cz; terrace tables go first.
verdict: If a guest wants the castle-and-roofs view with dinner, this is the one worth the money.
caveat: Hours and prices not published; the terrace is weather-dependent.

name: Villa Richter
neighborhood: Hradčany · on the Old Castle Steps, in the St Wenceslas vineyard
what_to_order: St Wenceslas vineyard wine · Vinobraní harvest festival
price_range: Not published online (Sept 2026)
verdict: Go for the vineyard and the view at aperitif hour; the food is not the reason.
caveat: Event-heavy: check it is not booked out for a wedding.

name: V Zátiší
neighborhood: Staré Město · Liliová, by Bethlehem Square, three minutes from Charles Bridge
recognition: MICHELIN Selected, Guide Czechia 2025 (the restaurant's own site claims a star; MICHELIN does not list one)
what_to_order: Tasting menu · Business lunch menu · Weekend brunch
price_range: Summer festival menu 1,395 CZK for three courses with a drink pairing (own site, summer 2026); tasting and à la carte also
reservation: Online or phone; private rooms by email vzatisi@zatisigroup.cz.
verdict: The practical grand room for a group: central, private rooms, open seven days.
caveat: Its own site overstates its MICHELIN status.

name: Kampa Park
neighborhood: Malá Strana · on Kampa island, the terrace at the foot of Charles Bridge
what_to_order: Honey-glazed duck breast · Rack of lamb · Black Angus steak · Olive-oil poached halibut · St Martin's goose menu
price_range: Mains 995-1,695 CZK; vegetarian 695 CZK; caviar 5,550 CZK (own menu page, Sept 2026)
reservation: Online; terrace tables go first in summer.
verdict: The spectacle version: book it for the bridge, not for the kitchen.
caveat: Main courses near 1,000-1,700 CZK; no guide recognition this cycle.
hot_this_month: St Martin's goose menu is a house fixture for 11 November; check the site in late October.

name: Mlýnec
neighborhood: Staré Město · Novotného lávka, the mill spur beside Charles Bridge
recognition: MICHELIN Selected, Guide Czechia 2025
what_to_order: 'The Most Popular' set menu · Tartare & Steak menu · Vegetarian set menu · Weekend brunch
price_range: MICHELIN €€€ band; set menus (Sept 2026)
reservation: Online via mlynec.apetee.com; last lunch booking 13:30 weekdays.
verdict: The river-view dinner to pick if the guest also cares about the plate.
caveat: Still bridge-adjacent pricing.

name: Restaurace Vltava
neighborhood: Nové Město · on the quay at Rašínovo nábřeží, between Palacký and Jirásek bridges
what_to_order: Carp à la Rožmberk · Grilled salmon with herbs · Roast beef in pepper sauce
price_range: Mains 269-349 CZK; desserts 125-155 CZK (own site, Sept 2026)
reservation: Walk in; call for the terrace on a Saturday.
verdict: The working river table: a quarter of the Charles Bridge price, same water.
caveat: Simple cooking; do not expect finesse.
hot_this_month: The Náplavka farmers market runs on the same quay every Saturday in October 2026 (3, 10, 17, 24, 31).

name: Loď Pivovar
neighborhood: Staré Město · moored at Dvořákovo nábřeží by Štefánik Bridge, mooring 19
what_to_order: Three year-round house beers · Seasonal specials · Grill on the summer deck
price_range: Not published on the pages read (Sept 2026)
reservation: Walk in for beer; email info@lodpivovar.cz for groups.
best_time: Late afternoon on the top deck
verdict: Go for a beer on the water; eat elsewhere if the food is the priority.
caveat: Hours and prices not confirmed this month.

name: Lokál Dlouhááá
neighborhood: Staré Město · north of Old Town Square, on Dlouhá
recognition: Listed by Prague City Tourism; The Infatuation 'Best Restaurants in Prague'
what_to_order: Svíčková (braised beef with cranberry jam) · Freshly mixed beef tartare · Fried edam with tartar sauce · Beef shin goulash · Pickled knackwurst (utopenec) · Tripe soup
price_range: Svíčková 325 Kč, schnitzel 355 Kč, tatarák 365 Kč (menu seen 27 Sept 2026)
reservation: Recommended for evenings; online on own site
verdict: The benchmark for tank Pilsner and pub cooking in the centre; start here and judge everything else against it.
caveat: It is on every list, so evenings are loud and full; the 1970s canteen décor is deliberate, not cosy.
hot_this_month: Daily board changes; on 28 Sept 2026 it listed bramborák with smoked meat and sauerkraut, 165 CZK.

name: U Kroka
neighborhood: Vyšehrad · below the fortress walls
recognition: Prague City Tourism listing; The Infatuation Prague guide
what_to_order: Svíčková na smetaně · Guláš · Roast duck · Kulajda · Garlic soup (česnečka)
price_range: Mid-range Czech pub prices; mains not published on site (checked Sept 2026)
verdict: The best reason to climb Vyšehrad after the view: a proper sauce in a room with regulars.
caveat: Small and popular; without a booking you will likely be turned away at dinner. Note the one-hour kitchen break.
hot_this_month: Daily 10:00–22:30; the Gothic garden beside the Franciscan garden before the cold sets in.

name: U Matěje
neighborhood: Praha 6 · Hanspaulka villas, under chestnut trees
recognition: Bib Gourmand, MICHELIN Guide Czechia
what_to_order: Carp fries with dill mayonnaise · Stuffed goose stomach and heart · Pulled goose with sauerkraut and potato pancakes · Svíčková
price_range: MICHELIN €€ (checked Sept 2026)
verdict: The most serious Czech cooking at pub prices in the city, worth the tram ride out.
caveat: A long way from the centre (tram to Hanspaulka, then a walk); book the garden in advance on warm days.

name: U Kalendů
neighborhood: Nové Město · on the Rašínovo embankment facing the Vltava
recognition: Bib Gourmand, MICHELIN Guide Czechia
what_to_order: Braised hare leg · Pork cheeks · Duck gizzards · Sweet yeast dumplings · House bread and toast loaf
price_range: MICHELIN €€ (checked Sept 2026)
reservation: Direct with the restaurant; the bakery is walk-in
verdict: The Czech kitchen at its most honest, with the city's best river-facing bread counter attached.
caveat: The mid-afternoon kitchen break catches people out; the menu is short by design.

name: SAPA (TTTM Sapa)
neighborhood: Praha 4-Libuš · the southern edge, bus from Kačerov
recognition: Radio Prague International feature (June 2025); Expats.cz
what_to_order: Bún chả at Hải Hà · Bánh cuốn at Phương Phượng · Duck at Dũng Liên · Crab soup at Sành Quán · Chè at Chè Sài Gòn · Bún cá Hải Phòng — with Czech carp
price_range: Bowls roughly 150–250 Kč (unverified range; no printed prices found, Sept 2026)
verdict: The single most un-Paris thing to eat in Prague, and the best half-day food trip in the city.
caveat: Bring cash; signage is mostly Vietnamese; the wholesale halls are not pretty and are not meant to be.

name: Hải Hà
neighborhood: SAPA, Libuš · follow the charcoal smoke
recognition: Named by Food on the Move (Sept 2026) and Czech SAPA food guides
what_to_order: Bún chả · Nem rán
price_range: Not published (Sept 2026)
verdict: If you eat one thing at SAPA, make it this.
caveat: Cash, crowds at lunch, no English menu guaranteed.

name: Pho Vietnam Tuan & Lan
neighborhood: Vinohrady · a cellar a few minutes from Náměstí Míru
recognition: The 20 Best Restaurants in Prague
what_to_order: Phở bò · Bún chả · Bánh cuốn
price_range: Budget; bowls priced for a weekday lunch (exact prices not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The one central phở worth the detour when SAPA is too far.
caveat: A cellar that gets very warm; service is quick, not chatty.

name: Bánh Mì Makers Dlouhá
neighborhood: Staré Město · Dlouhá 39, entrance from Hradební
what_to_order: Bánh mì · Phở · Bún chả · Daily home-cooking menu
price_range: Budget (menu prices not verified, Sept 2026)
verdict: The quick central lunch that is not a sausage.
caveat: Closed Sundays; the entrance is round the corner on Hradební.

name: Turkestan Restaurace
neighborhood: Žižkov · Bořivojova, among the old tenement pubs
recognition: The 20 Best Restaurants in Prague
what_to_order: Lagman · Plov · Ayran
price_range: Budget (menu prices not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The best reset meal in a beer city.
caveat: Little English or Czech spoken; opening hours not reliably published.

name: Polévkárna paní Mančo
neighborhood: Vinohrady · Bělehradská, a weekday soup counter
recognition: Prague City Tourism listing
what_to_order: Gruzínský boršč · Chinkali s masem · Chačapuri se sýrem · Adžaruli chačapuri · Harira
price_range: Borscht 130 Kč, khinkali (5) 290 Kč, adjaruli 330 Kč (own site, seen Sept 2026)
verdict: The most personal lunch counter in Vinohrady.
caveat: Weekdays only; hours disagree between sources, so arrive at lunch.

name: The Boršč
neighborhood: Vinohrady · U Vodárny, by the old water tower
recognition: PrahaIN (Oct 2023)
what_to_order: Beef borscht · Varenyky with chicken liver · Kotleta po-kyivsky · Syrnyky
price_range: Borscht 111 Kč, varenyky 192 Kč, Kyiv cutlet 267 Kč (PrahaIN, Oct 2023 — likely higher now)
verdict: A small, serious Ukrainian room; go for the soup and the varenyky.
caveat: Hours conflict between listings and the 2023 prices are dated; we could not confirm today's hours on an own site.

name: Dhaba Beas
neighborhood: All over Prague · central branch on Na Poříčí
address: Na Poříčí 26, Praha 1 (one of many branches)
what_to_order: Dal · Vegetable sabzi of the day · Chapati · Lassi
price_range: By weight; current price per 100 g posted in branch (Sept 2026)
verdict: The cheapest good vegetables in Prague, and a fair picture of how the city eats at noon.
caveat: Self-service and functional; the flavour is gentle Indian, tuned to Czech palates.

name: Café Savoy
neighborhood: Malá Strana / Újezd · at the Legion Bridge end of Vítězná
recognition: Taste of Prague (Sept 2026)
what_to_order: Viennese coffee · Pastry from the cabinet (with Myšák) · Savoy cake
price_range: Grand-café prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The grand-café breakfast to choose over the Old Town ones.
caveat: Reservations needed at weekends; a tourist favourite, priced like one.

name: Eska Karlín
neighborhood: Karlín · in a converted factory on Pernerova
recognition: Taste of Prague best bakeries; Kudy z nudy breakfast list
what_to_order: Bread 33 · Bread 66 · Koláč / buchta
price_range: Mid-range (menu prices not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The best bread-first breakfast in Prague; take a loaf back to the galley.
caveat: No reservations for the bakery; weekend queues from opening.

name: Bockem
neighborhood: Smíchov · a 26-seat room in an early-20th-century house
recognition: MICHELIN Selected (per own site)
what_to_order: Croque monsieur · Benedict soufflé · Morning Degustation
price_range: Upper mid-range (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The ambitious breakfast; book it for the one morning you want to sit for two hours.
caveat: No breakfast Mon–Wed; small room, book ahead.

name: Kantýna
neighborhood: Nové Město · a former bank off Wenceslas Square
recognition: Gault&Millau (per own site); The Infatuation 20 Best; Taste of Prague
what_to_order: Dry-aged steak · Bone marrow · Burger · Pastrami · Pig heart
price_range: Steak priced by weight at the counter (prices not published online, Sept 2026)
verdict: The best-run meat room in the centre and the easiest solo meal in town.
caveat: No reservations; peak hours mean queuing and standing.

name: Naše maso
neighborhood: Staré Město · Gurmet Pasáž on Dlouhá
what_to_order: Sekaná v housce · Burger · Steak tartare · House sausages
price_range: Budget to mid (counter prices not published, Sept 2026)
verdict: The fastest serious meat lunch in Prague, three doors from Lokál.
caveat: Tiny, standing room only; closed Sundays.

name: Výčep
neighborhood: Vinohrady · far end of Korunní
recognition: Bib Gourmand, MICHELIN Guide Czechia
what_to_order: Langoš with sheep's cheese and house-smoked cracklings · Short rib · Fire-grilled rainbow trout · Větrník
price_range: MICHELIN €€€ (checked Sept 2026)
verdict: The fire and the smokehouse of Moravia, in Vinohrady, at a Bib price.
caveat: Loud and crowded; it is a long walk out along Korunní.

name: Havelská Koruna
neighborhood: Staré Město · Havelská, by the market street
what_to_order: Svíčková na smetaně · Beef goulash · Dill sauce with beef (koprovka) · Chicken schnitzel
price_range: Svíčková 189 Kč, goulash 179 Kč, schnitzel 188 Kč (own site, Sept 2026)
verdict: The honest-price Czech plate in the Old Town.
caveat: Canteen lighting and trays; do not lose the ticket.

name: Jídelna Světozor
neighborhood: Nové Město · inside the Světozor passage off Wenceslas Square
what_to_order: Daily menu (soup, main, dessert) · Roast duck quarter, red cabbage · Smažený sýr · Segedínský guláš
price_range: Menu 169 Kč, duck 219 Kč (Meníčka.cz, 27 Sept 2026)
verdict: Lunch as pensioners and office workers eat it, steps from the square.
caveat: Lunch only; no evening service.

name: Centraal
neighborhood: Nové Město · on the Rašínovo embankment
recognition: Taste of Prague, new restaurants 2025
what_to_order: Hot chicken sandwich · Sparkling wine by the glass
price_range: Not published (Sept 2026)
verdict: The one fast plate in Prague worth planning around.
caveat: Closed Mondays; sells out.

name: U Fleků
neighborhood: Nové Město · Křemencova, near the National Theatre
what_to_order: Flekovský 13° dark lager · Roast pork with dumplings
price_range: Tourist pricing; check the menu before ordering (Sept 2026)
verdict: Go once for the beer and the history, refuse the shots, and eat elsewhere.
caveat: Tourist pricing and unrequested shots appear on the bill; say no clearly.

name: U Medvídků
neighborhood: Staré Město · Na Perštýně, off Národní
recognition: The Infatuation Prague guide
what_to_order: Budějovický Budvar · X-Beer 33
price_range: Central pub prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The better of the old central beer halls for actually drinking.
caveat: Also a hotel and a tour stop; the strongest-beer claim is marketing.

name: U Pinkasů
neighborhood: Nové Město · Jungmannovo náměstí, beside the Franciscan garden
recognition: Prague City Tourism
what_to_order: Pilsner Urquell · Velkopopovický Kozel dark
price_range: Central pub prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The pint with the best claim to history in Prague.
caveat: The food is standard Czech pub; the point is the beer and the place.

name: U Zlatého tygra
neighborhood: Staré Město · Husova, between Charles Street and Old Town Square
what_to_order: Pilsner Urquell · Pork neck with bread and mustard
price_range: Pub prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The most storied pint in Prague, in a room that has not been redecorated for visitors.
caveat: Regulars hold the tables; arrive at 15:00 opening to have a chance.

name: Letenský zámeček and the Letná beer garden
neighborhood: Letná · the park plateau above the Vltava
what_to_order: Lager in a cup · Klobása from the grill
price_range: Garden prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The one beer garden to see, on any dry afternoon.
caveat: The outdoor bar is seasonal and weather-bound; by late October it may be closed.
hot_this_month: Early October: garden may still run on dry afternoons; season end not published.

name: Parukářka
neighborhood: Žižkov · the hill of Svatý Kříž, above the TV tower streets
what_to_order: Draught beer · Bring-your-own grill
price_range: Pub prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The most local open-air beer in Prague.
caveat: Closing times are approximate; the outdoor stand ends late October.
hot_this_month: Outdoor stand runs until roughly late October 2026.

name: Žluté lázně
neighborhood: Podolí · on the right bank upstream of Vyšehrad
what_to_order: Grill · Neapolitan pizza · Gelato
price_range: Not published (Sept 2026)
verdict: A summer place; in October check before you go.
caveat: Seasonal; ticketed entry at times; season end not published.
hot_this_month: Season end not published; likely winding down in October.

name: Sisters
neighborhood: Staré Město · Dlouhá
what_to_order: Roast beef · Avocado and prosciutto · Pork tenderloin · Brie with cranberries · September special: eggplant with miso
price_range: 53–65 Kč per chlebíček (own site, Sept 2026)
verdict: The modern chlebíček counter; the classic ham-and-egg is elsewhere.
caveat: Standing counter; hours not published, go at lunch.

name: Libeřské lahůdky

price_range: Budget (per-piece prices vary by branch, Sept 2026)
verdict: The standard against which every new chlebíček is judged.
caveat: Chain shops vary; buy early before the tray thins.

name: Myšák
neighborhood: Nové Město · Vodičkova (also Holešovice market and Prague Castle)
what_to_order: Větrník · Laskonky · Chocolate-coated meringue
price_range: Cukrárna prices (not seen, Sept 2026)
verdict: The Prague cukrárna done properly, in the centre.
caveat: The Castle branch is priced for the Castle.
hot_this_month: The second Myšák, opened 2025 in Hall 27 of the renovated Holešovice market.

name: Erhartova cukrárna
neighborhood: Letná · Milady Horákové
what_to_order: Counter cakes · Macarons · Ice cream
price_range: Mini heart cake 590 Kč; themed cakes 2,100–2,900 Kč (own site, Sept 2026)
verdict: The local's cukrárna, not the tourist's.
caveat: Much of the business is custom cakes; the counter selection varies.

name: U Černého vola
neighborhood: Hradčany · Loretánské náměstí, opposite the Loreta
recognition: Plzeňský Prazdroj 'Velvet Revolution pubs' heritage listing
what_to_order: Kozel 12° · Kozel tmavý · Utopenci
price_range: Local pub prices (not verified Sept 2026)
verdict: The only pub worth your time on the castle hill, and one of the most honest rooms in Prague.
caveat: Small and often full; very little English spoken, simple food.

name: U Vystřelenýho oka
neighborhood: Žižkov · under Vítkov hill and the Žižka statue
what_to_order: Pilsner Urquell · Nakládaný hermelín
price_range: Neighbourhood prices (not verified Sept 2026)
verdict: The pub to understand Žižkov, the district with Prague's most pubs.
caveat: Smoky, noisy, ironic staff, cash only; the food is not the point.

name: Zlý časy
neighborhood: Nusle · a short tram ride south of Vinohrady
what_to_order: Rotating Czech lagers · Bottle shop
price_range: Craft-bar prices (not verified Sept 2026)
verdict: The best multitap in Prague for Czech beer rather than imported craft.
caveat: Out of the centre; tight tables; floors keep different hours.

name: Dva kohouti
neighborhood: Karlín · a courtyard off Sokolovská
what_to_order: Dva kohouti 12° · Seasonal specials
price_range: Not verified Sept 2026
verdict: The freshest beer-from-the-source experience in central Prague.
caveat: No bookings; packed on warm evenings.

name: Vinohradský pivovar
neighborhood: Vinohrady · Korunní, east end
